detail: DELETE TEST TC-BUG-55-07: Delete this case. TC-BUG-55-02 already submits a first wrong password and requires both the invalid-credentials message and absence of a lockout message; TC-BUG-55-01 also checks the invalid-credentials message.

DELETE TEST TC-BUG-55-03: Delete this case. TC-BUG-55-01 already checks the correct-password response during an active lockout and asserts the same message conditions. Seeding a distant lockout date adds no distinct contractual outcome, and this case does not advance time or repeat an attempt later to establish coverage across the lockout window.

The case explicitly requires preserving lockout and rejecting correct credentials. No ticket line requires this; 'What should happen' permits either successful sign-in or a plain explanation with an action. Remove the mandatory-refusal case and make retained scenarios accept either contractual outcome. Apply that correction to TC-BUG-55-01's mandatory refusal and TC-BUG-55-06's prerequisite that the locked account must be refused.
